Frozen Explorer:
(Under the influence of the Memory Crystal, the last memories of the Frozen Explorer gradually creep into your mind.)
Apparently, while creating these monsters Baluan was concerned with only one thing. He wanted them to be extremely powerful.
It is possible that he created many different monsters and then combined the strongest of them into a new form of life. I believe that is why all of the monsters here look very unnatural.
(This is the last memory. You can return to Priest of Light Torian.)
